sentence: Each person answers in, maybe or out for a trip, and the plan locks as soon as enough people are in.
use_when: A group needs a headcount before booking a cabin or other trip
A plan only goes ahead if a minimum number of people commit
You want to see who has answered and who is still missing
People may change or withdraw their answer before the plan is set
dont_use_when: You need to pick between several dates or places, which needs a poll
You need to split costs or track who has paid
The event has no minimum and you only want a simple yes or no RSVP
